text:
marta: Quick FYI — found a broken internal link + an image 403 on the compact runtime doc. Preview shows /docs/runtime/compact#batching returns 404 and the image at /assets/compact/kv-cache.png is 403. Anyone owns this page?

devon: pinging @lee and @samira — I think runtime docs fall under you two?

lee: @marta thanks for the report. Can you paste the exact doc URL and a screenshot of the 403?

marta: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/compact — repro steps: open page -> click "Batching" in the TOC -> 404. Also image renders as broken. The markdown shows: `![kv-cache](/assets/compact/kv-cache.png)`

samira: oh that was from my move last week, I renamed some asset folders. apologies. I can rehost the image to the docs CDN and update the md. I'll open a tiny PR.

samira: plan: 1) upload kv-cache.png to docs-cdn/images/compact/kv-cache.png 2) update markdown path and fix anchor from `#batching` -> `#batching-config` 3) add a frontmatter alias from the old anchor to avoid breaking links. I'll ping when PR is up.

marta: great, thanks :pray:

samira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3499 — small patch (image rehost + md tweak + aliases). @devon can you review when you have a sec?

devon: grabbing it now. quick heads-up: check the TOC generator — if we change the anchor name we may need a redirect or to update other pages linking to `#batching`.

lee: good catch. if we add frontmatter alias that should cover incoming links. also consider leaving a comment in the release notes for the change.

samira: added frontmatter alias: `aliases: ["/docs/runtime/compact#batching"]` and pushed. CI running.

devon: left one tiny nit about code fence spacing in the PR, otherwise LGTM.

samira: fixed and pushed. CI green. Want me to backport the change to `staging` branch too?

marta: yes please backport to staging so the site preview shows the fix for QA.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: snapshot to staging will start in ~10 minutes.

devon: thanks everyone — nice small sprint win :rocket:

marta: closing the loop — confirmed image loads in staging preview after deploy. :white_check_mark:
